Villa for Sale in Amaranta 2, Villanova


  Provident Real Estate is delighted to present this well-maintained 3-bedroom villa in the highly sought-after Amaranta community, Villanova. Offering a bright, functional layout and a prime location close to the community's key amenities, this home is an excellent choice for both end users and investors.


  Set within one of Dubai's most family-friendly communities, the villa combines comfort, privacy, and long-term value with easy access to parks, pools, schools, and major road networks.


  Property Features:


 3 Spacious Bedrooms
 Bright Open-Plan Living & Dining Area
 Modern Kitchen
 Private Garden
 Balcony
 Built-in Wardrobes
 Covered Parking
 Well-Maintained Condition
 Close to Pool & Park
 Vacant / Ready to Move In (remove if not applicable)


  Community Highlights:


 Family-Oriented Community
 Landscaped Parks & Walking Trails
 Swimming Pools & Children's Play Areas
 Retail & Dining Options Nearby
 Easy Access to Emirates Road & Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road
 Strong Rental Demand & Excellent Investment Potential


  Whether you're looking for your next family home or a smart investment in one of Dubai's fastest-growing communities, this villa offers an outstanding opportunity.


  Contact Provident Real Estate today to arrange your private viewing.
